scenes.title: Galti Se Selection
narration: Tum canteen dhoondh rahe the. Pahunch gaye auditorium. Meera ne mike pakda diya — 'NEXT! Dialogue bolo: MAIN AA GAYA!' Tumne ghabra ke bola — 'Main... aa gaya? ...canteen dhoondh raha tha.'
Pin-drop silence. Phir Meera chillayi — 'NATURAL! RAW! EMOTIONAL! SELECTED!' Taaliyan baj gayin. Kabir ne chashma neeche karke dekha — 'Bro... ye mera competition hai? Cute.'
Ab tum 'Tapri Tales' ke... kuch ho. Role abhi decide nahi. Pehle Bablu ki tapri par 'welcome cutting' — team ka riwaaz.
fallbackLines: Team tapri par tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai. Pehla impression matters — kya attitude leke jaaoge?
Meera ne script ka bundle tumhe thamaya hai — 40 pages, climax missing. Kya karoge?

choices.text: Full josh — 'Team, trophy is baar hamari!'
Humbly — 'Main naya hoon, seekhne aaya hoon'

memory: User humble entry ke saath team mein aaya — Bablu impress.

scenes.title: Pehli Rehearsal
narration: Rehearsal mein pata chala: tumhara role hai NARRATOR — poora play tumhari awaaz par khada hai! Meera boli — 'Backbone! No pressure!'
Tabhi Kabir ka phone baja — film audition ka call! 'Guys, fest wale din mera audition bhi hai... dekhte hain.' Meera ka chehra laal — 'DEKHTE HAIN?!'
Break mein Bablu ne cutting di — 'Ek team tab toot-ti hai jab log ek-doosre ke sapne chhote samajhte hain. Kabir se baat karoge, ya Meera ka saath doge?'
fallbackLines: Kabir corner mein phone par laga hai, Meera script phaad rahi hai (gusse mein, literally). Tum kiske paas jaaoge?
Narrator ka role tumhara hai — par team bikhar rahi hai. Pehle team, phir dialogue.

choices.text: Kabir se dil se baat karta/karti hoon

memory: User ne Kabir se dil se baat ki — wo audition aur fest dono ko leke phansa hai.

choices.text: Meera ka saath deta/deti hoon — rehearsal pe focus

scenes.title: Script Crisis
narration: Din 5. Badi khabar: script ka climax likhne wala senior... hostel chhod ke chala gaya! Climax MISSING. Meera ne sar pakad liya — 'Ab?!'
Professor Iyer bole — 'Best plays are written by the team, not one writer. Tum sab milke likho.' Bablu ne cutting rakhi — 'Climax wahi achha jo dil se nikle. Batao — play kis baare mein hai?'
Sab tumhe dekh rahe hain. Narrator ho — kahani tumhari zubaan mein khatm hogi. Climax idea tum do!
fallbackLines: 'Tapri Tales' ka climax tumhe likhna hai. Dosti? Sapne? Ya full comedy twist?
Meera pen leke ready hai. Bablu ne kaha — 'Jo dil se nikle, wahi likh.'

memory: User ne play ka dosti-wala emotional climax likha.
User ne play ka comedy-twist climax likha.

scenes.title: Final Rehearsal Disaster
narration: Din 9. Final rehearsal. Aur... KABIR GAYAB! Phone switched off! Meera pagal ho gayi — 'Maine kaha tha! Star banega! Show khatm! CLUB KHATM!'
Professor Iyer shaant bole — 'Show must go on. Understudy kaun hai?' Sabki nazrein... TUM par. Narrator + lead DONO?!
Bablu tapri se dauda aaya (pehli baar tapri chhod ke!) — 'Beta, darr mat. Dhol बजेga, lights jalengi, aur tu... tu bas dil se bolna. Baaki Bablu sambhal lega.'
fallbackLines: Kal fest hai. Kabir gayab hai. Lead role tumhe mil raha hai. Accept karoge — ya Kabir ko dhoondhoge?
Meera ro rahi hai (chhupa ke). Team tumhe dekh rahi hai. Faisla tumhara.

choices.text: Lead role accept karta/karti hoon — show must go on!
Kabir ko dhoondhne jaata/jaati hoon — team adhoori nahi hogi

memory: User Kabir ko manane gaya — dosti nibhai.

scenes.title: Show Time!
narration: Udaan fest. 10,000 log. Parda uthne mein 2 minute. Backstage pin-drop silence... aur tabhi — KABIR DAUD KE AAYA! 'Audition... postpone... ho gaya! MAIN AA GAYA! ...tumne mera role to nahi le liya, bro?'
Meera ne use gale laga liya (phir thappad bhi). 'Dono taiyaar?!' Dhol baja. Lights jali. Narrator ki awaaz goonji — TUMHARI awaaz.
Play chal raha hai. Climax aa raha hai. Audience saans roke hai. Aur tabhi — LIGHTS FLICKER! Pichhle saal jaisa...?
fallbackLines: Lights flicker ho rahi hain! Audience mein halchal! Narrator ke roop mein tum stage sambhal sakte ho — kuch bolo!
Ye tumhara moment hai. Darr? Ya dialogue?

choices.text: Improvise karta/karti hoon — lights ko play ka hissa bana deta/deti hoon
Team ko cue deta/deti hoon — sab milke dhol-finale karte hain

scenes.title: Ending: Narrator Superstar
narration: Tumne lights ki taraf dekh ke bola — 'Aur tab tapri ki batti gul hui... par dosti ki roshni kabhi nahi bujhti!' AUDIENCE PAAGAL! Standing ovation!
Best Play + Best Narrator — DONO trophy drama club ke paas! Kabir ne trophy tumhe di — 'Bro... ye teri hai. Kabir aaj side-hero ban ke khush hai.'
Bablu ne 500 cutting free baanti. Uski tapri par naya board laga — 'Narrator Special: Cutting Free (trophy winners ke liye)'.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Team Trophy
narration: Dhol baja, poori team stage par, aur audience bhi taali bajane lagi! Lights wapas aayi — par tab tak show already HIT tha!
Judges bole — 'Best ENSEMBLE performance in Udaan history!' Trophy mili — poori TEAM ko. Meera royi, Kabir ne sabko hug kiya, Iyer sir ne filter coffee pilayi.
Bablu ki tapri par party — usne kaha: 'Dekha? Team means chai sabke liye. Aur trophy... trophy bhi sabke liye!'
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

endings.title: Narrator Superstar
endings.description: Improvise karke show bachaya, Best Narrator bane.

endings.title: Team Trophy
endings.description: Poori team ke saath Best Ensemble jeeta.
